text_block_list.text:
The "Nakayama Kinen"... Ahead of the 
spring season, top Umamusume gather to 
compete in this race. In recent years, 
many girls aim for overseas races starting 
from here.

Competing against girls with overseas 
ambitions will surely be good experience 
for Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Physically, I'm completely 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: You came to cheer me on, huh?
You came to cheer me on, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for taking the time out 
of your busy schedule.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I will show Big Sis Groove a magnificent 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you realize it yourself, but you 
have a tendency to shoulder too much on 
your own.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There doesn't seem to be any sign of that 
lately, but... sometimes you don't notice 
these things yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
choice_data_list: I'm keeping a close eye on things too.
I'm watching properly too, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I simply cannot shake the impression of 
her from when she was a young child. Even 
though I have already watched her current 
running style countless times.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...With your run today, will you rewrite 
it for me?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'll run a race that will make Big Sis 
Groove proud. —I promise.
